policy: Exact single-source CL2 site identity and pre-existing master source URL required
Site contact and named associated community only; no new current Mass, liturgical or canonical assertion

Where the listed telephone belongs to a serving priory, the bilingual note must identify that distinct source-contact scope; never imply a direct chapel telephone.
